'''2008 Worlds Team John Veasey DS Ralltiir Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[John Veasey]] at [[2008 World Championship]] (Team Tournament). Sheet title Too late / Too Lat. Sheet spelling Veasy normalized to Veasey from inventory. Abbreviations expanded best-effort. Line 60 blank; 11 shields listed.


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[John Veasey]]

* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS16]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire|Ralltiir Operations]]
* '''Stage:''' Team Tournament
